term.label: stop_gained_NMD_triggering

definition.text: A stop_gained (SO:0001587) variant that is degraded by nonsense-mediated decay (NMD).

comments: Added as per request from Ang Roberts as part of GenCC November 2020.

firstSeen.subject: Added terms SO:0002319 through SO:0002328 related to whether variants trigger NMD or escape NMD in response to GitHub Issue request #521 from the Gene Curation Coalition (GenCC)
